Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:10:1.hebrew: דלמא לענין חומש קאמרת - הך מעילה לאו מעילה ממש קאמר, ולא בנהנה מן ההקדש, אלא בחומש קאמר, ובבא לפדות הקדש קאמר. וקרי לחומש מעילה משום דבמעילה נמי שייך חומש, ולמעוטי הקדש שני אתא, וכדרבי יהושע בן לוי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:10:1.english: Perhaps you are saying [this] with regard to the matter of one-fifth - [By] this "misuse [of consecrated property]," he does not mean actual misuse, nor is he speaking of one who derives benefit from consecrated property; rather, he is speaking of the [added] fifth, and he is speaking of one who comes to redeem consecrated property. And he calls the [added] fifth "misuse" because in misuse [of consecrated property] as well, a fifth applies; and it comes to exclude a second consecration, and [this is] in accordance with [the statement of] Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:1:1.hebrew: ש"מ חומשו כמותו - דמשתלם פירות ולא מעות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:1:1.english: Learn from it [that] its one-fifth [is] like it - That it is paid [with] produce and not money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:2:1.hebrew: גבי גזל כתיב - גבי אשם גזילות כתיב, אם גזל וכפר ונשבע לשקר, "חמישיתיו" — חמישיות הרבה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:2:1.english: With regard to robbery it is written - With regard to the guilt-offering for robbery it is written — if he robbed, denied [it], and swore falsely — "its fifths" [in the plural, meaning] many fifths.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:2:2.english: And we learned [in a Mishnah] - [There are] also times when there are many [one-fifths].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:2:3.hebrew: נתן לו את הקרן - לאחר שנשבע והודה ונתחייב קרן וחומש, ונשבע לו על החומש — שחזר וכפר את החומש ואמר "נתתיו לך", ונשבע והודה — הרי זה מוסיף חומש על חומש שכפר. וכן אם חזר ונתן לו חומש ראשון שנשבע עליו, וחזר וכפר ונשבע על חומש שני והודה, מוסיף חומש על חומש שני, וכן לעולם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:2:3.english: He gave him the principal - [This is] after he swore [falsely] and confessed, and became liable for the principal and a fifth. And [when the Mishnah states,] "he swore to him concerning the fifth" — [this means] that he went back and denied [owing] the fifth, saying, "I gave it to you," and swore [falsely] and confessed — he adds a fifth onto the fifth that he denied. And similarly, if he went back and gave him the first fifth about which he had sworn, and went back and denied and swore [falsely] concerning the second fifth and confessed, he adds a fifth onto the second fifth, and so on indefinitely.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:2:4.hebrew: עד שיתמעט הקרן - חומש שהוא מחוייב כבר וחוזר וכופרו קרוי קרן, עד שתהא כפירת שבועתו בפחות משוה פרוטה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:2:4.english: Until the principal is reduced - A one-fifth [payment] that he is already obligated [to pay] and again denies is called "principal," until the denial of his oath is for less than the value of a peruta.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:3:1.english: With regard to terumah - [one who] eats terumah unwittingly.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:3:2.hebrew: כתיב חמישיתו - דלא משמע אלא חד חומש, ואפ"ה תנן בה חומשא דחומשא. כגון אם נתן קרן וחומש מן החולין כמשפטו, ונעשו התשלומין תרומה, וחזר ואכל אותו חומש, משלם אותו וחומשו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:3:2.english: It is written, "its fifth" - Which implies only one fifth, and even so we learned [in the Mishnah] regarding it [the law of] a fifth of a fifth. For example, if he gave principal and a fifth from non-sacred [produce] as required by its law, and the payment became teruma, and he then ate that fifth, he pays it and its fifth.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:3:3.hebrew: ואחד הסך - שמן של תרומה, דסיכה כשתייה ושתייה כאכילה, דאמרינן בפ' בתרא [דיומא] (דף עו.): שתייה כאכילה מואכלת לפני ה' וגו', וכתיב ביה תירושך; וסיכה כשתייה, דכתיב: "ותבא כמים בקרבו וכשמן בעצמותיו". אבל אם ביערה על ידי דבר אחר, אינו משלם חומש, ד"איש כי יאכל קדש" כתיב — פרט למזיק את התרומה על ידי דבר שאינה אכילה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:3:3.english: Or one who anoints [himself] - [with] oil of terumah, for anointing is like drinking and drinking is like eating, as we say in the last chapter [of Yoma] (76a): Drinking is like eating, from "And you shall eat before the Lord, etc.", and it is written in it "your new wine"; and anointing is like drinking, as it is written: "And it came like water into his inward parts, and like oil into his bones." However, if he destroyed it through some other means, he does not pay the fifth, for "If a man eats that which is sacred" is written — excluding one who damages terumah through something that is not eating.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:3:4.hebrew: גבי מעשר - גבי פדיון מעשר שני, דכתיב ביה נמי "וחמישיתו יוסף עליו":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:3:4.english: With regard to tithe - [That is,] regarding the redemption of second tithe, concerning which it is also written: "he shall add its one-fifth to it."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:3:5.english: It is not written regarding it - [any] implication of multiple fifths.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:3:6.hebrew: ולא מיתנא תנא ביה - חומשא דחומשא, כגון אם חזר וחילל את החומש הראשון:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:3:6.english: Nor was it taught regarding it - [i.e.,] a fifth of a fifth, for example, if he subsequently redeemed the first fifth.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:3:7.hebrew: ולא איבעויי מיבעיא לן - אם מוסיף חומש על חומש אם לא, דפשיטא לן דלא מוסיף, דלא אשכחן ביה רמז בקרא כדאשכחן בתרומה רמז פורתא, כדבעינן למימר קמן. דבתרומה כתיב ויסף חמישיתו ולא כתיב יסף כדגבי מעשר, ולשון ויסף משמע שתי תוספות — יוסיף וחוזר ויוסיף — אבל יסף חדא משמע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:3:7.english: Nor was it raised as a dilemma before us - [Namely,] whether one adds a fifth upon a fifth or not, for it is obvious to us that one does not add [a fifth upon a fifth], since we do not find an allusion to it in the verse as we find regarding teruma a slight allusion, as we are going to state further on. For regarding teruma it is written, “and he shall add [veyasaf] its fifth,” and it is not written “he shall add [yosef],” as [it is] regarding tithe; and the expression veyasaf implies two additions — he shall add and add again — whereas yosef implies [only] one.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:4:1.hebrew: גבי הקדש - הפודה את הקדשו, כתיב: "ואם המקדיש יגאל ויסף חמישית כסף ערכך":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:4:1.english: With regard to consecrated property - [That is,] one who redeems his consecrated property, [about which] it is written: "And if he who consecrated [it] will redeem [his house], then he shall add one-fifth of the money of your valuation."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:4:2.hebrew: הכי גרסינן ותנן הפודה את הקדשו מוסיף חומש - ובמתני' דפירקין הוא, ולא גרסינן "הנהנה מן ההקדש שוה פרוטה" כו', דההיא במעילה קא מיירי. וגבי מעילה לא כתיב "ויסף" אלא "יסף", ולא כתיב "חמישית" אלא "חמישיתו", "ואת אשר חטא מן הקדש ישלם" וגו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:4:2.english: This is how we read [the text]: "And we learned: One who redeems his consecrated [property] adds one-fifth" - And it is in the Mishnah of our chapter. We do not read: "One who derives benefit from consecrated [property] worth a peruta," etc., for that [mishna] speaks of misappropriation [of consecrated property] (me'ilah), and regarding misappropriation it is not written veyasaf ("then he shall add"), but rather yosef ("he shall add"), and it is not written chamishit ("one-fifth"), but rather chamishito ("its fifth"), [as it is written:] "And that which he has sinned against the holy thing he shall make restitution for," etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:4:3.hebrew: מאי - אם חזר וחילל את החומש, מהו שיוסיף חומש? מי אמרינן: האי דגבי תרומה — אע"ג דלא כתיב "חמישיתיו" — תנן בה חומש דחומשא משום דכתיב "ויסף", דמשמע שתי תוספות; אי טעמא משום משמעותא הוא, הכא נמי כתיב "ויסף", וחייב להוסיף:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:4:3.english: What [is the halakha] - If he went back and redeemed the fifth, what is [the law] as to whether he must add a fifth [on it]? Do we say [that] that which regarding teruma — even though "its fifths" [plural] is not written — we learned in the Mishnah regarding it [that one adds] a fifth of the fifth, is because "and he shall add" is written, which implies two additions; [so] if the reason is because of [that] implication, here too "and he shall add" is written, and he is obligated to add [a fifth of the fifth]?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:5:1.hebrew: או דלמא - טעמא דתרומה לאו משום משמעותא הוא, אלא משום דקיימא לן גורעין ומוסיפין ודורשין. הלכך, ויסף דגבי תרומה, כי שקלת לה ו' דויסף — ותיקרי ביה יסף חמישיתו — ושדי ליה בסוף חמישיתיו, אתקרי חמישיתיו בשני ווין, ונשתמע חמישיות הרבה. אבל הכא גבי הקדש, דלא כתיב אלא חמישית, אע"ג דשקלת כו'. ואם תאמר: נישדייה באמצע תיבה, ונקרי חמישיות כסף ערכך? לא אשכחן גורעין ומוסיפין להפסיק את התיבה, אלא או בראשה או בסופה, כדאמרינן בסדר יומא (דף מח.): ולקח מדם הפר — דם מהפר יקבלנו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:5:1.english: Or perhaps - The reason for teruma is not because of [the plain] implication [of the verse], rather because we hold [the exegetical principle that] we subtract, add, and expound. Therefore, [regarding the word] veyasaf written in connection with teruma: when you take the vav of veyasaf — and read it as yasaf ḥamishito — and cast it to the end of ḥamishito, it is read ḥamishitav with two vavs, and many fifths are implied. However, here regarding consecrated property, where only ḥamishit is written, even though you take [the vav], etc. And if you say: Let us cast it into the middle of the word, and read ḥamishiyot kesef erkecha ["fifths of the money of your valuation"]? We do not find [the principle of] "we subtract and add" [applied] to split a word, rather only at its beginning or at its end, as we say in Seder Yoma (48a): "And he shall take from the blood [midam] of the bull" — [meaning] blood from the bull [dam me'hapar] he shall receive.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:6:1.hebrew: תיפוק ליה כו' - מאי קמבעי' ליה לרבא? תיפוק ליה דאם חזר וחילל את החומש הראשון אין מוסיף חומש, דהוה ליה הקדש שני; אפילו חזר וחילל קרן עצמו שהתפיס תחת הראשון, אין מוסיף חומש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:6:1.english: Let it be derived, etc. - What was Rava's question? Let it be derived that if one went back and redeemed the first fifth, he does not add a fifth, since it is a second consecration; [for] even if he went back and redeemed the principal itself that he substituted for the first [consecration], he does not add a fifth.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:6:2.hebrew: וא"ר יהושע בן לוי כו' - ויליף לה מקרא בשמעתא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:6:2.english: And Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said, etc. - And he derives it from a verse in the discussion.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:6:3.hebrew: חומש כתחלת הקדש דמי - שהרי מאיליו ניתוסף, ולא נתפס תחת הראשון. הלכך, בעיין מטעם דהקדש שני לא תיפשוט ליה; משום הכי מספקא ליה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:6:3.english: The fifth is like initial consecration - For behold, it was added on its own and was not taken in place of the first [consecrated item]. Therefore, you cannot resolve our question on account of [the rule of] second consecration; because of that, he is in doubt.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:8:1.hebrew: המתפיס - זה תחת הראשון, שהשני נתפס בקדושה של אחר, ולא מחמת עצמה באה לו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:8:1.english: One who associates - [That is, one who consecrates] this in place of the first, for the second becomes attached to the sanctity of another, and [its sanctity] does not come to it on its own.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:9:1.hebrew: ואם בבהמה הטמאה - הוה ליה למכתב "ואם בהמה טמאה" כו', "ואם בבהמה" מאי היא? אלא הכי קאמר: בהקדשות שהן כבהמה טמאה קאמר לך קרא "ויסף חמישיתו":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:9:1.english: And if [it is] of the non-kosher animal - It should have written, "And if [it is] a non-kosher animal," etc. — what is [the meaning of] "And if [it is] of an animal"? Rather, this is what it is saying: concerning consecrated items that are like a non-kosher animal, the verse tells you, "he shall add its fifth."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:9:2.hebrew: מה בהמה טמאה תחלתה הקדש - ולקמיה פריך: מי לא משכחת לה נמי שתהא הקדש שני, שיתפיסנה לבדק הבית תחת בדק הבית אחר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:9:2.english: Just as a non-kosher animal [is an example of] initial consecration - And further on, [the Gemara] asks: Is it not also found to be a secondary consecration, where one consecrates it for the Temple upkeep in place of another [item consecrated for] the Temple upkeep?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:9:3.hebrew: וכולה לשמים - שאין לבעלים בה כלום, דסתם הקדש בהמה טמאה לבדק הבית היא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:9:3.english: And it is entirely to Heaven - That the owners have nothing in it, for an unspecified consecration of a non-kosher animal is for Temple upkeep.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:9:4.hebrew: ומועלין בה - השתא קס"ד דמעילה ממש קאמר, ולא אפשר ליה לאוקומא הכי: חדא, דקרא לא במעילה משתעי; ועוד, דאפילו לית גבה כל הני, שייכא מעילה לענין הקדש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 54b:9:4.english: And one commits misuse with it - At this point, we assume that he is speaking of actual misuse [of consecrated property], and it is impossible to establish [his statement] thus: firstly, because the verse does not speak of misuse; and furthermore, because even where all these [conditions] are not present in it, misuse applies with respect to consecrated property.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:10:1.hebrew: בשלמא כולה לשמים למעוטי כו' - דלית בהו מעילה, ה"מ למפרך: הא קרא במעילה לא משתעי:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:10:1.english: Granted, "entirely to Heaven" [serves] to exclude, etc. - that they are not subject to me'ilah [misuse of consecrated property]; [he] could have objected: Behold, the verse does not speak of me'ilah.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:10:2.hebrew: הקדש ומעשר - הפוכים זה מזה, דמעשר אין מוסיף חומש על חומש, ועל חלול שני מוסיף חומש, כדאמר בהתודה (שם), והקדש הוי איפכא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:10:2.english: Consecrated property and tithe - [They] are the opposite of each other: for [with] tithe, one does not add a fifth upon a fifth, while upon a second redemption one does add a fifth, as [the Gemara] states in [chapter] HaTodah (ibid.), whereas consecrated property is the opposite.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:10:3.hebrew: דלמא לענין חומש קאמר - וא"ת: הא כבר ממעטינן הקדש שני מן ״המקדיש״ ולא מן ״המתפיס״? וי"ל: דקרא דלעיל מיירי במקדיש ביתו, והכא מיירי בבהמה טמאה דהוי מטלטלין, וצריכי. ומשום הכי לעיל נמי איצטריך ״כסף ערכו״ להוסיף חומש על חומש, משום דלא כתיב ״חמישיתו״ גבי מקדיש ביתו, אע"ג דבקרא דמקדיש בהמה טמאה כתיב ״ויסף חמישיתו״. (ותרוייהו ב״אם בחוקותי״):
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:10:3.english: Perhaps [it is] with regard to one-fifth [that] he is saying [this] - And if you ask: Have we not already excluded second consecration from [the phrase] "the one who consecrates," and not "the one who transfers [sanctity]"? And one can answer that the verse above deals with one who consecrates his house, whereas here [the baraita] deals with a non-kosher animal, which is movable property, and both [verses] are necessary. And for this reason, above as well, [the phrase] "the money of your valuation" was needed to add a fifth upon a fifth, because "its fifth" is not written regarding one who consecrates his house, even though in the verse of one who consecrates a non-kosher animal it is written, "and he shall add its fifth." (And both [verses] are in [Parashat] Im Bechukotai).

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:10:4.hebrew: לענין חומש קאמרת - פרש"י: "ומועלי' בה" — היינו: ומוסיף חומש. ותימה: והלא שלמים אינה כולה לשמים, ומוסיף חומש, כדאמר בהתודה (שם)! וי"ל: דבמסקנא דתורת כהנים מרבה אף קדשים קלים; והכי איתא התם: "מה יש לי לרבות? פרים הנשרפים ושעירים הנשרפים. מנין לרבות קדשי קדשים וקדשים קלים? ת"ל: 'בבהמה טמאה', 'ואם כל בהמה טמאה'". וכי פריך לעיל: "בשלמא 'כולה לשמים' — למעוטי קדשים קלים, דליכא מעילה", לא מסיק אדעתיה מסוף הברייתא, דמרבה אף קדשים קלים:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:10:4.english: With regard to the matter of one-fifth you are saying [this] - Rashi explained [that] "and they are subject to misuse through it" means: and he adds a fifth. And [this is] astonishing: surely a peace-offering is not entirely to Heaven, yet one adds a fifth, as it says in [the chapter] HaTodah (there)! And one can answer that in the conclusion of Torat Kohanim it includes even offerings of lesser sanctity; and thus it is stated there: "What do I have to include? Bulls that are burned and goats that are burned. From where [do we derive] to include offerings of the most sacred order and offerings of lesser sanctity? The verse states: 'of an unclean animal,' 'and if any unclean animal.'" And when [the Gemara] asked above: "Granted, 'entirely to Heaven' [serves] to exclude offerings of lesser sanctity, for there is no misuse," it did not bear in mind the end of the baraita, which includes even offerings of lesser sanctity:

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:2:1.hebrew: מוסיף חומש על חומש - וא"ת: והא לעיל בריש פירקין (בבא מציעא דף מח.) בעינן יחד לו כלי, או נטל וחזר והפקידו אצלו? וי"ל: דמ"מ ס"ד כיון שבא מתורת חומש, לא מייתי עליה קרבן ואין מוסיף עליה חומש אחר; קמ"ל:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:2:1.english: [He] adds a fifth upon a fifth - And if you ask: Behold, earlier, at the beginning of our chapter (Bava Metzia 48a), we require [that] he designated a vessel for him, or he took [it] and returned and deposited it with him! And one can answer: That nevertheless, it would enter our mind [to think that] since it comes by way of a fifth, he does not bring a sacrifice for it and does not add another fifth upon it; [therefore, it] teaches us [that he does].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:3:1.hebrew: ולא מיתנא תנא - לא הן ולא לאו. וא"ת: והתנן במסכת מעשר שני (פ"ב מ"ו): "סלע של חולין ומעשר שנתערבו — מביא בסלע מעות", ולא קתני "בסלע וחומש מעות", אלמא תנן דאין מוסיף חומש על חומש? וי"ל: דלא חשש להזכיר אותו חומש. תדע, שהרי על קרן שני מוסיף חומש, כדתני בהתודה (מנחות דף פב. ושם): "המתפיס מעות מעשר שני בשלמים, כשהוא פודה מוסיף ב' חומשין, אחד למעשר ואחד לקדש", ואפ"ה לא קתני "מביא בסלע וחומשו של קרן מעות":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:3:1.english: Nor was it taught [in a Mishnah] - Neither yes nor no. And if you will say: But did we not learn in Tractate Ma'aser Sheni (2:6): "[If] a sela of non-sacred [money] and [a sela of second] tithe became mixed together, he brings coins [worth] a sela," and it does not teach "coins [worth] a sela and a fifth" — thus we [did] learn that one does not add a fifth upon a fifth? One can answer that [the Tanna] was not concerned to mention that fifth. Know [that this is so], for on a second principal one [certainly] adds a fifth, as it is taught in [the chapter] HaTodah (Menachot 82a and there): "One who designates second-tithe coins as a peace-offering, when he redeems [it], he adds two fifths: one for the tithe and one for the consecrated [offering]," and even so it does not teach [in Ma'aser Sheni] "he brings coins [worth] a sela and the fifth of the principal."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:7:1.hebrew: מה כסף ערכו כו' - ומעליו לא מצי דריש כדפרישית לעיל, ומכסף ערכו נמי לא מצי מפיק שלא יתחלל על הקרקע — דלא אתא אלא לאורויי דכי איתיה לחומש בעולם, הוי דינו כמו קרן להוסיף עליו חומש:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 54b:7:1.english: "Just as the money of its valuation, etc." - And from [the word] "unto it" [in that verse], [the Gemara] could not expound [that one adds a fifth upon a fifth], as I explained above; nor can one derive from [the phrase] "money of its valuation" that [the fifth] cannot be redeemed onto land, for [the comparison] only comes to teach that when the fifth is in existence, its law is like [that of] the principal, to add a fifth upon it.
